title: Kestrel and the Salt Revisited
author: Mara Kavanagh
blurb: Sable Dravenmoor, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, has spent ten years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
